customManagers.description: shellcheck version pinned in ci.yml (checksum needs a manual refresh; CI fails loudly if it's stale)
rubyfmt version pinned in support/latest (checksums need a manual refresh via support/sync-versions.sh; CI fails loudly if stale)
actionlint download script, SHA-pinned with a version comment in ci.yml (same convention as our uses:@sha # vX.Y.Z action pins)

prBodyNotes: This bumps a version pin only. The checksum(s) in this file were **not** updated automatically — CI will fail with a checksum mismatch until they're refreshed. For `fables-tales/rubyfmt`, run `support/sync-versions.sh <tag>`. For `koalaman/shellcheck`, recompute the sha256 of the new release's `shellcheck-<version>.linux.x86_64.tar.xz` asset and update `SHELLCHECK_SHA256` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
